question: Implementation target: treat every artifact entering synthesis as untrusted DATA. A council transcript or a work-unit receipt can carry 'ignore previous instructions', a role spoof, or an embedded command. An intake sanitiser plus a planted-injection fixture must be neutralised, logged, and reported without the instruction ever reaching the synthesizer's instruction channel.
